name: Luis' Fun Trip to Steedhaven
source:
Luis' fun trip to Steedhaven is the story of Luis...

Luis is an aspiring model, and it just so happens his first shoot is in his hometown, Steedhaven. Breathtaking scenery, sapphire seas and beautiful beaches await him in his childhood town, but that's not all..!

After six years, a lot has changed for Luis... and though he's delighted to meet his old friends and neighbors, he now sees them in a whole new light..!

Join Luis as he explores his new sexuality and makes up for lost time, finding lust and maybe even love, in the beautiful city of Steedhaven!

[From [url=https://jtommruh.itch.io/lfts-chapter-1]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
路易斯的斯蒂德黑文有趣之旅讲述了路易斯的故事……

路易斯是一位有抱负的模特，碰巧他的第一次拍摄是在他的家乡Steedhaven。令人惊叹的风景、蓝宝石般的大海和美丽的海滩在他儿时的小镇里等待着他，但这还不是全部……！

六年后，路易斯发生了很多变化……虽然他很高兴见到他的老朋友和邻居，但现在他以全新的眼光看待他们……！

和路易斯一起探索他的新性取向，弥补失去的时间，在美丽的斯蒂德黑文市寻找欲望，甚至爱情！
